name: KopiCat
summary:
KopiCAT is a cat feeding simulator where stray cats will strut into your shelter as if they own the place. Feed them, and maybe they will leave you with gifts. Discover their quirks, win their favor, and maybe, JUST MAYBE, your shop will be allowed thrive.

The game was made by animal-loving folks at Twilight Foundry Games in a 4-day internal game jam. KopiCAT is a pilot project for the DevCares Initiative.
